QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_47

question.text: The 'Performance Risk' category in a Cat III PPM typically includes:

answer.text: Only credit risk of underlying investees
Risks from investment strategy, dependence on manager, liquidity of fund investments, concentration and distribution of income

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 7 of the XIX-E workbook, Performance Risk covers multiple factors: potential loss of investment, investment strategy speculativeness, unsuccessful first close, dependence on investment manager, incentive-fee misalignment, liquidity/realisation, concentration, distribution of income, co-investments, geo-political risks. The Trap: A/C/D each describe only a fragment and miss the breadth. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B Cat III Distributor teaches the same taxonomy from a client-explanation angle. Manager's Pro-Tip: When drafting a Cat III PPM, enumerate Performance Risks in a labelled sub-section with each sub-risk called out. Regulators (and LP counsel) review this list line-by-line.
